tenderSchedule.title: OPERATION & HOUSEKEEPING SERVICES OF MACHINERIES IN BTPS WORKSHOP FOR A PERIOD OF ONE YEAR
tenderSchedule.description: Operation & house-keeping services of machineries in BTPS workshop for a period of one year.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer MM Office BTPS Bellary

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of EE(MM)BTPS, KPCL, Kudatini, Bellary

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Contractor shall deploy/engage only the qualified/ experienced/skilled personnel along with responsible supervisor as per the scope of work

It is the responsibility of the contractor to carry out the designated work under his supervision and call for KPCL inspection after completion. Hence it is the duty of the contractor to engage suitable experienced staff for each work and complete the work within stipulated time

The Personnel deployed by the Agency shall be the employees of the contractors only. The corporation at no time directly or indirectly employs the agency for any service of deal with any personnel in any capacity during the tenure of the contract

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The intending bidder should have experience in the field of Operation or Maintenance of work shop Machineries in any industrial establishments. The bidder should have satisfactorily completed above said work as a prime contractor in a single work order of value not less than Rs.10.41 Lakhs in any one year during preceding five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26. As a documental proof, the intending bidder shall furnish work order and satisfactory work done certificate for the same work certified by the competent authority (Scanned copy of original documents to be uploaded). Work done Values of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work Order and Workdone Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have achieved an average annual financial turn-over of Rs.20.81 Lakhs in any two of the preceding five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26. (Scanned copy of original documents to be uploaded). The contractor shall submit audited copy of balance sheet and profit loss account statement duly certified by registered charted accountant. Financial Turnover Values of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.
